newsitem.title: USA: CBOT's Arbor takes medical leave for next 10 days.
newsitem.headline: CBOT's Arbor takes medical leave for next 10 days.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade chairman Patrick Arbor said he will take medical leave for the next 10 business days after undergoing surgery on Thursday for the removal of a benign tumor from his right lung.
"I now face a short recovery period following a brief hospital stay," Arbor said in a letter to CBOT members. "I plan to be back fulfilling my duties as chairman as soon as my doctors allow."
Arbor said he would stay in contact with CBOT president Thomas Donovan and the Executive Committee on a daily basis. Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuter.com
